reasoning: On the season so far the Pacers are the stronger team; with home court the Pacers start about 3 points better, in a game of about 239 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Bulls.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pacers win 51 times in 100; most games like this end between 213 and 262 total points.
